تواترت (form VI)
# تَوَاتَرْتُ (tawātartu) /ta.waː.tar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَوَاتَرَ (tawātara)
# تَوَاتَرْتَ (tawātarta) /ta.waː.tar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَوَاتَرَ (tawātara)
# تَوَاتَرْتِ (tawātarti) /ta.waː.tar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَوَاتَرَ (tawātara)
# تَوَاتَرَتْ (tawātarat) /ta.waː.ta.rat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
